learning_objectives: Explore f(x)=m*x+q, f(x)=a*x^2+b*x+c and f(x)=a*x^n with sliders on equally scaled coordinate axes
Distinguish the roles of slope, intercept, polynomial coefficients and positive integer degree
Investigate even and odd power-function symmetry and the effect of a nonzero coefficient
Compare f(x)=a*x^n and g(x)=a*x^m with one shared coefficient and independent positive integer degrees
Recognize that a=0 removes the quadratic term or gives the zero function, excluded from the stated power-function definition
Explore how m and q affect the graph of f(x)=m*x+q and compare it with quadratic and power functions
Explore how a, b and c affect the graph of f(x)=a*x^2+b*x+c and compare it with linear and power functions
